name: superpowers-architecture
description: Architecture-first Superpowers for Codex and GPT-6 Astra: stage-aware design, evidence-gated compatibility, reversible decisions, TDD, and subtractive review.

interface.shortDescription: Architecture-first Superpowers for Codex and GPT-6 Astra
interface.longDescription: Take a project from foundation through design, planning, implementation, review, and verification in Codex, optimized for GPT-6 Astra. Match durability and compatibility to evidenced consumers and data obligations. Prefer reversible choices, explicitly retire obsolete requirements through immutable artifact successors, classify tests by active contract, and review complexity budgets and temporary-code sunsets. All 16 skills, architecture phases, TDD, and reviews remain. Autonomous is the default; Review-gated is an explicit opt-in. Invoke using-superpowers explicitly; automatic startup and complete installed-host flows remain unverified.
defaultPrompt: Use wayfinder to establish my project foundation, maturity, data durability, and reset authority.
Use brainstorming to design one bounded outcome with the simplest reversible option, then implement and verify it.
Review my codebase architecture, identify current consumers, and recommend what can be simplified or removed.
